questions.stem: When decane (C10H22) is cracked to produce octane (C8H18) and one other product, what is that other product?
questions.explanation: Balancing the equation: C10H22 -> C8H18 + ? The missing product needs 10-8 = 2 carbons and 22-18 = 4 hydrogens, giving C2H4 (ethene). Cracking always produces at least one alkene. Ethene is particularly valuable for making polymers like poly(ethene).

questions.stem: Why is ethene described as the most important petrochemical?

options.text: It is the cheapest hydrocarbon to produce
It is the starting material for many products including poly(ethene), ethanol, and PVC
It is the main fuel used in power stations
It is the most abundant gas in crude oil

questions.explanation: Ethene is the most produced organic chemical globally because its reactive C=C double bond allows it to undergo many useful reactions. It is used to make poly(ethene) by polymerisation, ethanol by hydration, and PVC via chloroethene. It is the essential starting material for the polymer industry.
